title: legacy_decay.dem duplicates advance_fire.dem verbatim — all its golden artifacts are byte-identical to the 6.2 golden
evidence: demos/legacy_decay.dem directives: `seed 20261 / run 70000ms / era 2 / fixture qos / advance gate on / at 0ms draw 0 1 standard / at 0ms draw 1 2 standard / at 0ms draw 3 1 standard / at 0ms draw 4 1 standard / capture at 15000ms / capture at 60000ms` — comment-stripped diff vs demos/advance_fire.dem is EMPTY. `cmp goldens/advance_fire.log.bin goldens/legacy_decay.log.bin` → IDENTICAL (109 bytes); `diff goldens/advance_fire.t1 goldens/legacy_decay.t1` → only `demo advance_fire` vs `demo legacy_decay` (all 1400 hash lines identical); both T2 PNGs (`15000ms.png`, `60000ms.png`) cmp-identical. Only duplicated directive set among all 48 demos.
detail: A simpler alternative existed: reuse the re-blessed advance_fire golden as the decayed half and bless only legacy_modernized. Defensible as story-named pair + decoupling from future gate-demo retunes, but nothing keeps the twins aligned.
recommended_fix: Keep the named pair if desired, but extend legacy_decay.dem's header comment from "The advance_fire shape" to state the directive set is byte-identical, so future retunes consciously sync or split both.

title: Twin T1 manifests differ from tick 1 although ticks 1-600 are behaviorally identical — the pre-fire diff is action-log fold, not decay
evidence: legacy_decay.t1 line: `1 50761a164094001a`; legacy_modernized.t1 line: `1 ce4beeed63ede01e` — yet both demos share the identical pre-fire directives (draws at 0ms, fire at tick 600, modernizes land at apply_tick 601 per the log binary) and goldens/legacy_decay/15000ms.png ≡ goldens/legacy_modernized/15000ms.png (md5 c0b168e63cc570d0da9f2c907cd7f474 both). Mechanism — core/serialize.odin state_writer: `w_u32(&w, u32(len(state.action_log)))` + per-command records hash the 4 extra Cmd_Set_Pipe_Tier entries from tick 1. legacy_modernized.dem comment claims "same ticks, same demand, only the legacy state differs".
detail: The comment overstates what the manifest diff shows pre-fire: 600 hash lines differ purely by the log fold. A reader diffing the manifests may mistake log-fold divergence at ticks 1-600 for behavioral divergence.
recommended_fix: Add one line to legacy_modernized.dem's header: pre-fire T1 lines differ only via the action-log hash section; behavioral identity is pinned by the byte-identical 15000ms capture.
